mapper.sql: c.course_id AS courseId, c.name AS title, c.description AS description, c.type AS type, NULLIF(c.thumbnail_url, '') AS thumbnailUrl, c.place_cnt AS placeCnt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM course c WHERE c.is_active = TRUE ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.course_id DESC
SELECT FROM course c WHERE c.is_active = TRUE AND c.course_id = #{courseId}

SELECT cp.sort_order AS courseSeqNo, p.place_id AS placeId, p.place_name AS placeName, NULLIF(p.first_image, '') AS image, CONCAT_WS(' ', p.add1, NULLIF(p.add2, '')) AS address, p.map_y AS latitude, p.map_x AS longitude FROM course_place cp JOIN place p ON p.place_id = cp.place_id AND p.is_active = TRUE WHERE cp.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY cp.sort_order ASC, cp.course_place_id ASC
